resolution_criteria:
If H finishes in 2nd place in the 2025 Norwegian parliamentary election in Norway according to the certified results, then the market resolves to Yes.
Ranking is determined by the specified counting method. For proportional representation: rank follows the electoral authority's final seat allocation order. In case of exact ties, markets resolve proportionally (1/number of tied entities). If the election is cancelled or postponed beyond expiration, all markets resolve to No.
query_used: What is the result of this question "Will H finish 2nd in Norway"

Not even a statistician can make any claims that something systematic is taking place here, based on the results from a ... marked against the distribution of such \\(Z\_A\\) drawn under the condition of fairness. So Conclusion One is that there's a serious advantage for the A skiers, those coming from the first semifinal: they tend, in a crystal clear statistical sense, over time, to have better ranks, to be more often on the podium, than the B skiers. Conclusion One, though already important, does not yet help us understand to what extentthe Olympic setup is unfair.
